headline: Umno is collecting Najib's RM50m fine into a party account. No law limits or names the donors.
context: On 18 September 2026 the Pardons Board made Najib Razak's house arrest conditional on paying a RM50 million fine set in 2024. Umno launched a fund the same day. Malaysia has no political-financing law. A government committee recommended one in 2016; the minister now says 2027.

cards.big: Najib's RM50 million fine became a condition of house arrest on 18 September. By evening Umno was collecting for it in a party account: RM634,562 in three hours, by its own count.
cards.sub: No law caps a gift to a party or names the giver in public. The Bar calls the gap a lacuna; the minister says 2027.

cards.big: Tabung Solidariti Najib Razak takes gifts into an account in Umno's registered name, supervised by party HQ. Its launch set no cap, donor rule or audit.
cards.sub: Accounts go to the Registrar of Societies; under section 10(2) only members may obtain them. A fine is not campaign money; the gap is the same.

cards.big: Najib announced the committee that first recommended the Act on 14 August 2015, amid the furore over RM2.6 billion in his accounts. The minister now says 2027.
cards.sub: It reported in 2016. Buku Harapan pledged the Act in 2018. GIACC said 'next month' in 2019. Cabinet agreed in principle to draft it in 2023.

cards.big: On 8 September the minister drafting the Act said, as a lawyer: without it 'many politicians will be charged with corruption'.
cards.sub: Azalina Othman Said is also Umno information chief. A 2026 index put PKR, DAP, Amanah, Bersatu and PAS all under 30% on financial accountability; none names donors.

cards.big: A fine can be crowdfunded through a party account only members may see. That is not a loophole in the political-financing law. There is no such law.
It is like a bank that promised a know-your-customer rule in 2015, studied it under four governments, and still takes deposits with no form to fill.
cards.sub: The 2016 committee wrote the form: gifts above RM3,000 reported within 30 days, foreign cash banned, government contractors barred, no cap on amounts.

cards.big: The fine is raised in an account only party members may see, under a law that does not exist. Pakatan Harapan promised it in 2018; its government says 2027. One is a choice.
